name: Spixi
tagline: A private messenger with calls, files, and a crypto wallet
description:
Spixi is an all-in-one communication app built around strong, future-proof encryption designed to resist even quantum computers. Send messages, make calls, share files, and chat with friends, all without relying on a central company's servers.

It also includes a built-in crypto wallet and small add-on apps, and since you hold your own keys, no one else can read your conversations or act on your behalf.
